column1: # CIAAW Abridged Standard Atomic Weights 2024, transcribed as printed at https://ciaaw.org/abridged-atomic-weights.htm (read 2026-11-07).
# "The most recent Standard Atomic Weights are presented in this Table and they are based on the 'Atomic Weights 2021' report"; Gd, Lu and Zr
# were revised by the CIAAW in 2024. "In 2013, the Commission recommended that standard atomic weights are best abridged to five digits."
# Columns: Z, symbol, abridged standard atomic weight as printed (trailing zeros kept), the +- as printed (CIAAW calls it a conservative
# simplified measure of reliability: Prohaska et al. 2022, section 7; `-` = the page prints a dash, no value), footnote letters as printed,
# and mass_number: NOT a CIAAW value, the convention of physure.conf for an element with no standard atomic weight (same as the standard table).
# The Rust test tests/atomic_weights_ciaaw.rs holds the [AtomicWeights:abridged] section of physure.conf to this file.
